items.name: Reported revenue
items.meaning: Issuer-reported non-financial revenue for the stated window and scope; not bank net interest income or normalized growth.

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Comparable consolidated windows, eligible original vintage; endpoint operands require later reviewed construction.

authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: Reported EBIT
items.meaning: Explicitly reconciled issuer EBIT; not any operating-profit label and not automatically normalized EBIT.

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Comparable definition and documented cycle/one-off normalization before scoring.

authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: Reported net income
items.meaning: Reported total net profit after tax in the stated consolidation scope, including minority interests when present; not common-attributable profit.

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Only reported evidence; normalization and attribution need separate lineage.

authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: Reported common-attributable net income
items.meaning: Reported net profit attributable to common shareholders; attribution must be evidenced, not inferred from total net income.

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Reported fact supports review; ROE requires normalized profit and average common equity, neither inferred here.

authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: Total assets
items.meaning: Reported total assets at the balance-sheet date and stated scope.
authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: Common equity
items.meaning: Equity attributable to common shareholders excluding minority/preferred interests as applicable, not automatically total equity.

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Average common equity is a later governed derivation from comparable dated balances.

authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: Operating cash flow
items.meaning: Issuer net cash from operating activities over the stated window; unrelated to investor portfolio cash.

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Comparable multi-year cumulative CFO/normalized NPAT; bank CFO substitution prohibited.

operandMappings.requirement: Compatible non-financial reporting window; capex definition and sign reconciled; no automatic scoring.

authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: Issuer capital expenditure
items.meaning: Positive issuer expenditure required to sustain/grow operations, explicitly identified/reconciled from disclosed capex items; not investing cash flow.

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Disclose total vs maintenance capex; no inference from total investing outflow.

operandMappings.requirement: Positive issuer expenditure for compatible CFO window; maintenance vs total scope documented.

authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: Reported Borrowings
items.meaning: Issuer-reported carrying borrowing population plus all identified qualifying financing, current portions once; unknown miscellaneous liabilities retained as uncertainty.
authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: Comprehensive Financial Debt
items.meaning: Exhaustively verified consolidated interest-bearing financing population on approved compatible carrying basis; not an alias of reported borrowings.
authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: Unrestricted Economically Available Cash
items.meaning: Explicitly issuer-qualified unrestricted economically available stock; reported CASH_AND_EQUIVALENTS is not automatically eligible.
authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: Normalized Ebitda
items.meaning: Independently qualified normalized/downside EBITDA with explicit compatible sector lease policy; never automatic annualization.
authorityReferences: REVIEW_ONLY: original definition retained; no base/debt approval imported

items.name: BANK CUSTOMER DEPOSITS
items.meaning: Reported customer deposits; not interbank funding or all liabilities.

items.name: BANK GROSS CUSTOMER LOANS
items.meaning: Reported gross customer-loan population before loss allowances; not total credit risk assets.

items.name: BANK NET INTEREST INCOME
items.meaning: Reported net interest income; not total operating income.

items.name: BANK REPORTED CAR
items.meaning: Issuer-reported capital adequacy ratio under the stated framework and regulatory consolidation scope; preserve CCB basis.

items.name: BANK REPORTED CET1
items.meaning: Reported common equity tier1 ratio; never substitute total tier1 or CAR.

items.name: TOTAL EQUITY
items.meaning: Reported total equity including NCI where present; not common equity or tangible book value.

items.name: BANK LOAN LOSS RESERVES
items.meaning: Reported loan-loss allowance for the explicitly qualified loan population.

items.name: CURRENT ASSETS
items.meaning: Reported current assets; not all assets or bank liquidity.

items.name: INVENTORY
items.meaning: Reported inventory at stated carrying amount; not project realizable NAV.

items.name: SHORT TERM FINANCIAL BORROWINGS
items.meaning: Reported current financial borrowings including source-qualified current portions once.

items.name: LONG TERM FINANCIAL BORROWINGS
items.meaning: Reported noncurrent financial borrowings; avoid double-counting current portions.

items.name: CURRENT LIABILITIES
items.meaning: Reported current liabilities; not financial debt.

items.name: RECEIVABLES
items.meaning: Reported receivables for the source caption population; not automatically collectible cash.

items.name: CASH AND EQUIVALENTS
items.meaning: Reported cash and cash equivalents; not automatically unrestricted economically available cash.

items.name: CASH CAPEX REPORTED
items.meaning: Reported cash payments for source-qualified investing/reinvestment captions; not normalized maintenance capex.

items.name: BASIC EPS
items.meaning: Reported basic EPS for the stated period and share basis; not normalized or action-adjusted EPS.

items.name: GROSS PROFIT
items.meaning: Reported gross profit; not EBIT.

items.name: NET INCOME ATTRIBUTABLE PARENT
items.meaning: Reported after-tax profit attributable to parent owners; not automatically common-share earnings.

items.name: OPERATING PROFIT
items.meaning: Issuer-caption operating profit; not automatically normalized EBIT.

items.name: FINANCIAL DEBT
items.meaning: Securities issuer financing population from reviewed borrowing/bond/other qualifying financing evidence; never total liabilities.

items.name: SECURITIES MARGIN LOANS
items.meaning: Gross margin-loan principal at carrying/original amount; exclude settlement advances and fair-value column unless specifically justified.

items.name: BANK REPORTED NPL
items.meaning: Reported NPL ratio with explicit numerator/denominator population; not silently loan-only or total-credit substituted.

items.name: CONVERTIBLE AND EXCHANGEABLE BOND LIABILITIES
items.meaning: Issuer-recognized convertible/exchangeable financing liability carrying amount; equity/options remain separate.

items.name: SHORT TERM FINANCIAL BORROWINGS

items.name: CURRENT LIABILITIES

items.name: RECEIVABLES

items.name: CASH AND EQUIVALENTS

items.name: CASH CAPEX REPORTED

items.name: BASIC EPS

items.name: GROSS PROFIT

items.name: NET INCOME ATTRIBUTABLE PARENT
items.meaning: Reported after-tax profit attributable to parent owners; not automatically common-share earnings.

items.name: OPERATING PROFIT

items.name: FINANCIAL DEBT
items.meaning: Securities issuer financing population from reviewed borrowing/bond/other qualifying financing evidence; never total liabilities.
